questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the e/4 gate period? Is the device in Fig. 1b the one measured, and over how many cooldowns?
If other devices or cooldowns were measured, why were they set aside?
Which ranges of antidot gate, side gate, displacement field and magnetic field did you measure beyond the ones shown, and did you look at the "developing states at ν = +1/2 and +5/2" (p. 2)?
What does the second-best dataset look like at each even-denominator filling, for example a second map at ν = −5/2, where the oscillations are weakest (Fig. S8)?
What are the ratios ∆V/∆V1 at ν = −5/2, −1/2 and 3/2 when you normalize to ν = −1 at 14 T, the field of the fractional data (Fig. S3)?

Your text gives "p = 10, 2, and 6" (p. 4), while Fig. 4a seems to show about 7, 3 and 7.5. How were the text values obtained, and how many field periods does each map hold at the 1 mT step (Fig. 2a spans about 35 mT)?
Did you repeat fixed-field gate sweeps at the three even-denominator fillings, as at ν = 2/3 (Fig. S13), and measure gate leakage at base temperature?
Can you extract a charging energy and a level spacing from the DC-bias maps (Fig. S8c to S11c) in the minimal regime, and say what in them places the e/4 oscillations in the Coulomb-dominated regime?
